claims: Subaru Outback sales declined by 42.9% in March 2026.
Subaru Outback sales in March 2026 were 10,004 units.
Subaru Outback sales declined by 32.2% in Q1 2026.
Subaru Outback sales in Q1 2026 were 27,074 units.
Subaru Outback sales in Q1 2025 were 39,934 units.
Subaru total sales fell by 23.5% in March 2026 compared to the previous year.
The 2026 Subaru Outback redesign shifted the model from a wagon-like silhouette to a more conventional SUV shape.
Reports suggest that some 2026 Subaru Outback models have seen price jumps of over $5,000.
